name: FA_ITF_IMPAIRMENTS
description: FA_ITF_IMPAIRMENTS contains information about impairment transactions.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the impairment transaction.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: CASH_GENERATING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the cash generating unit.

columns.name: NET_BOOK_VALUE
columns.description: Net book value of an asset is the current cost minus total reserve, times the accumulated depreciation plus bonus reserve.

columns.name: NET_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Price for selling the asset net of cost of removal.

columns.name: VALUE_IN_USE
columns.description: Asset value in use for impairment evaluation.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount of the asset.

columns.name: YTD_IMPAIRMENT
columns.description: Year-to-date impairment amount.

columns.name: GOODWILL_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is a goodwill asset.

columns.name: DEPRN_RUN_DATE
columns.description: The system date when depreciation was run.

columns.name: DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Asset depreciation expense amount.

columns.name: YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total depreciation expense including the bonus depreciation recognized for the asset.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: Depreciable basis of the asset, calculated as recoverable cost for cost basis depreciation methods, and recoverable cost less the accumulated depreciation for net book value basis methods.

columns.name: BONUS_RATE
columns.description: Bonus rate used to calculate bonus depreciation.

columns.name: LTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Life-to-date production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period.

columns.name: PRODUCTION
columns.description: Current period production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION
columns.description: Amount of revaluation reserve amortized during the current period.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION_BASIS
columns.description: Revaluation reserve used in calculating amortization of revaluation reserve. Updated only when the asset is revalued or has an amortized adjustment.

columns.name: REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Portion of depreciation expense generated due to revaluation of the asset cost. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. It is for reporting only.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Change in the net book value due to revaluation of asset cost and sometimes also revaluation of depreciation reserve for revaluation period. For all other periods, the revaluation reserve amount after depreciation run.

columns.name: YTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Year-to-date production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: YTD_REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense due to revaluation. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. It is for reporting only.

columns.name: PRIOR_FY_EXPENSE
columns.description: Depreciation expense of prior fiscal years.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense. Amount is included in DEPRN_AMOUNT.

columns.name: BONUS_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Bonus year-to-date depreciation expense. Amount is included in YTD_DEPRN.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total bonus depreciation taken since the beginning of the asset life. Amount is included in DEPRN_RESERVE.

columns.name: PRIOR_FY_BONUS_EXPENSE
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense from prior fiscal years.

columns.name: DEPRN_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator as to whether the depreciation amount for the period is overridden or not.

columns.name: SYSTEM_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: System calculated depreciation amount.

columns.name: SYSTEM_BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: System calculated bonus depreciation amount.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation adjustment amount.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change in the net book value due to depreciation reserve adjustment for revaluation period. For all other periods, the revaluation reserve amount after depreciation run.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: PERIOD_OF_ADDITION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator as to whether asset is currently in the period of addition or not.

columns.name: CURRENT_UNITS
columns.description: Current number of units for the asset.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset category.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the impairment transaction occurs.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for parallel processing.

columns.name: PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: Internal identifier indicating the order in which transactions should be processed.

columns.name: RATE_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Internal factor used to adjust depreciation rates to depreciate the net book value over the remaining life.

columns.name: FORMULA_FACTOR
columns.description: Factor used to adjust the depreciation rate for formula-net book value method assets.

columns.name: EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve at the end of the previous fiscal year.

columns.name: IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: The type of impairment being defined.

columns.name: REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the impairment transaction.

columns.name: SPLIT_IMPAIR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the impairment is split or not. A value of Y means that the impairment is split. Any other value indicates that the impairment is not split.

columns.name: SPLIT1_IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: Impairment classification type for first splitting reason. Reasons can be consumption of economic benefit, change in property classes or other reason.

columns.name: SPLIT1_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the first impairment split.

columns.name: SPLIT1_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount internally calculated due to first split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT1_REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Amount of revaluation reserve adjusted by first split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT1_PERCENT
columns.description: Split percentage due to first split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT1_PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: Order in which the first split was processed.

columns.name: SPLIT2_IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: Impairment classification type for first splitting reason. Reasons can be consumption of economic benefit, change in property classes or other reason.

columns.name: SPLIT2_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the second impairment split.

columns.name: SPLIT2_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount internally calculated due to second split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT2_REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Amount of revaluation reserve adjusted by second split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT2_PERCENT
columns.description: Split percentage due to second split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT2_PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: Order in which the second split was processed.

columns.name: SPLIT3_IMPAIR_CLASS
columns.description: Impairment classification type for third splitting reason. Reasons can be consumption of economic benefit, change in property classes or other reason.

columns.name: SPLIT3_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the third impairment split.

columns.name: SPLIT3_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount internally calculated due to third split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT3_REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Amount of Revaluation Reserve adjusted by third split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT3_PERCENT
columns.description: Split percentage due to third split reason.

columns.name: SPLIT3_PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: Order in which the third split was processed.

columns.name: CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT
columns.description: Value of capital adjustment after considering impairment transaction.

columns.name: GENERAL_FUND
columns.description: Value of general fund after considering impairment effect.

columns.name: REVERSED_IMP_AMT
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to impairment loss account reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_IMP_AMT_S1
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to impairment loss account reversed due to first split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_IMP_AMT_S2
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to impairment loss account reversed due to second split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_IMP_AMT_S3
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to impairment loss account reversed due to third split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_DEPRN_IMPACT
columns.description: Amount of depreciation impact attributed to income and expense account reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_DEPRN_IMPACT_S1
columns.description: Amount of depreciation impact attributed to income and expense account reversed due to first split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_DEPRN_IMPACT_S2
columns.description: Amount of depreciation impact attributed to income and expense account reversed due to second split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_DEPRN_IMPACT_S3
columns.description: Amount of depreciation impact attributed to income and expense account reversed due to third split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_AMT
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_AMT_S1
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed due to first split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_AMT_S2
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed due to second split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_AMT_S3
columns.description: Amount of impairment loss amount attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed due to third split reason.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_IMPACT
columns.description: Amount of depreciation impact attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_IMPACT_S1
columns.description: Amount of first split depreciation impact attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_IMPACT_S2
columns.description: Amount of second split depreciation impact attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed.

columns.name: REVERSED_REVAL_IMPACT_S3
columns.description: Amount of third split depreciation impact attributed to revaluation reserve account reversed.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Total impairment loss recognized for the asset.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation limit amount for the asset.

columns.name: HISTORICAL_NET_BOOK_VALUE
columns.description: Asset net book value if no impairment loss is recognized.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IMPAIR_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated impairment expense.

columns.name: REVAL_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation loss balance.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation amortization.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: YTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Year-to-date annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: LTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Total annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annuity interest expense adjustment amount.

columns.name: AUTO_POST_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an asset transaction should be automatically posted after approval.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the asset transaction approval.
